commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'commands='; for c in nginx haproxy curl systemctl sudo; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s ' "$c"; done; printf '\n'
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl is-active haproxy 2>/dev/null || true
commands.error: The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired
